import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem factorial_quadratic_plus_linear_le (n : ℕ) (h₀ : 5 ≤ n) : n ^ 2 + n ≤ Nat.factorial n := by
  have h₁ : ∀ n ≥ 5, n ^ 2 + n ≤ Nat.factorial n := by
    intro n hn
    induction' hn with n hn IH
    · 
      norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    · 
      cases n with
      | zero => contradiction 
      | succ n =>
        cases n with
        | zero => contradiction 
        | succ n =>
          cases n with
          | zero => contradiction 
          | succ n =>
            cases n with
            | zero => contradiction 
            | succ n =>
              cases n with
              | zero => contradiction 
              | succ n =>
                simp_all [Nat.factorial, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul]
                <;>
                (try ring_nf at * ) <;>
                (try nlinarith) <;>
                (try omega) <;>
                (try
                  {
                    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (n + 5), sq_nonneg (n + 4), sq_nonneg (n + 3), sq_nonneg (n + 2),
                      sq_nonneg (n + 1)]
                  }) <;>
                (try
                  {
                    ring_nf at *
                    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (n + 5), sq_nonneg (n + 4), sq_nonneg (n + 3), sq_nonneg (n + 2),
                      sq_nonneg (n + 1)]
                  }) <;>
                (try
                  {
                    ring_nf at *
                    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (n + 5), sq_nonneg (n + 4), sq_nonneg (n + 3), sq_nonneg (n + 2),
                      sq_nonneg (n + 1)]
                  })
  exact h₁ n h₀

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem factorial_quadratic_plus_linear_le (n : ℕ) (h₀ : 5 ≤ n) : n ^ 2 + n ≤ Nat.factorial n := by
  have hpred : n - 2 ≤ (n - 2)! := by
    exact Nat.self_le_factorial (n - 2)
  have hmul : (n - 1) * (n - 2) ≤ (n - 1) * (n - 2)! := by
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n - 1) hpred
  have hsub1 : n - 1 = n - 2 + 1 := by
    omega
  have hsub2 : n = n - 2 + 2 := by
    omega
  have hgrowth : n + 1 ≤ (n - 1)! := by
    have hrec : (n - 1) * (n - 2)! = (n - 1)! := by
      exact Nat.mul_factorial_pred (by omega)
    rw [← hrec]
    nlinarith [hmul]
  have hfact : n * (n - 1)! = n ! := by
    exact Nat.mul_factorial_pred (by omega)
  calc
    n ^ 2 + n = n * (n + 1) := by ring
    _ ≤ n * (n - 1)! := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n hgrowth
    _ = n ! := hfact

theorem factorial_quadratic_plus_linear_le (n : ℕ) (h₀ : 5 ≤ n) : n ^ 2 + n ≤ Nat.factorial n := by

    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        intro hk
        omega
    | succ k ih =>
        intro hk
        by_cases h5 : 5 ≤ k
        · have hik := ih h5
          have hsq : 25 ≤ k * k := by
            exact Nat.mul_le_mul h5 h5
          have hsmall : k + 2 ≤ k * (k + 1) := by
            nlinarith
          have hmul :
              (k + 1) * (k + 2) ≤ (k + 1) * (k * (k + 1)) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left (k + 1) hsmall
          have hfactorial :
              (k ^ 2 + k) * (k + 1) ≤ Nat.factorial k * (k + 1) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_right (k + 1) hik
          calc
            (Nat.succ k) ^ 2 + Nat.succ k =
                (k + 1) * (k + 2) := by
                  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
                  ring
            _ ≤ (k + 1) * (k * (k + 1)) := hmul
            _ = (k ^ 2 + k) * (k + 1) := by ring
            _ ≤ Nat.factorial k * (k + 1) := hfactorial
            _ = Nat.factorial (Nat.succ k) := by
              rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
              ring
        · have hk4 : k = 4 := by
            omega
          subst hk4
          norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  exact H n h₀
